about.hero_h1: We built Allybi for people who can't afford chaos or surveillance.
about.hero_support: Sensitive work deserves tools that feel calm, clear, private, and trustworthy.
about.why_p1: Every day, professionals in legal, finance, and business handle hundreds of documents they did not create. Contracts arrive in different formats. Spreadsheets get duplicated. Slide decks proliferate across inboxes. Finding the right file at the right time becomes a tax on every decision you make.
about.why_p2: Most AI tools promise to fix this, but they introduce a new problem: they require you to hand over your data with no transparency about how it is used, stored, or trained on. For teams working with sensitive information, that tradeoff is not acceptable.
about.why_p3: Allybi was built to eliminate both problems. One workspace where you can search, organize, edit, and act on your documents, with AI that is grounded in your files and respects your privacy at every step.
about.convictions_title: The problem we refuse to accept
about.conviction_1_title: You should not have to trade privacy for speed.
about.conviction_1_desc: Fast answers should not come at the cost of exposing your most sensitive files to opaque systems. Privacy and performance belong together.
about.conviction_2_title: You should not have to remember every filename to act quickly.
about.conviction_2_desc: Searching by exact name is a relic. You should be able to ask for what you need in plain language and find it instantly.
about.conviction_3_title: AI should help without inventing certainty.
about.conviction_3_desc: When AI answers your question, it should cite the source. When it does not know, it should say so. Grounded outputs are the only outputs worth trusting.
about.principle_1_desc: Every screen, every result, and every action should be immediately understandable. No feature bloat. No noise.
about.principle_2_desc: You decide what gets shared, sent, or changed. AI assists; you confirm. No silent automation, no hidden side effects.
about.principle_3_desc: Every AI answer cites its source. You can trace the reasoning, check the file, and verify before acting.
about.principle_4_desc: Good tools reduce anxiety, not add to it. Allybi is designed to feel quiet, organized, and predictable.
about.principle_5_desc: Your files are encrypted, isolated, and never used for model training. Privacy is not a feature toggle. It is the architecture.
about.principle_6_desc: Allybi helps you move faster — but never at the cost of accuracy. Every answer is sourced, every action is verified, every send is confirmed.
about.grounded_p1: Allybi grounds every AI response in the documents you have uploaded. This means answers come from your files, not from the open internet or from general model knowledge. When the AI references a clause, a number, or a date, you can trace it back to the exact source.
about.grounded_p2: You control what files are included, what connections are active, and what actions the AI can take. Before anything is sent, shared, or changed, Allybi asks for your explicit confirmation. Nothing leaves your workspace without your approval.
about.grounded_p3: This is not a privacy policy add-on. It is how the product is built.
about.building_p1: One private workspace where you can search across all your documents, organize them by project or client, edit files directly, and take action, all without switching between five different tools.
about.building_p2: Less time hunting for the right file. Fewer wrong-version mistakes. Faster, calmer work on the things that actually matter.
about.build_1_desc: Speed to clarity. Answer with sources that cite sources. User control at every step. We measure success by how quickly you can move from question to confident action.
about.build_2_desc: Sell your data. Train models on your files without explicit consent. Hide where AI-generated answers come from. These are not future commitments. They are current architecture decisions.
about.build_3_desc: Privacy first. Evidence over opinion. Ship and iterate. Every feature ships with the question: does this make sensitive work calmer and more trustworthy?

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How does Allybi handle attorney-client privilege?
faq.a1: Allybi workspaces are isolated and encrypted. Your documents are never shared across accounts, never used for model training, and never accessible to Allybi staff. You control who has access to each project, and all data processing respects the confidentiality of your files.
faq.q2: Can I compare specific clauses across documents?
faq.a2: Yes. Upload multiple document versions and ask Allybi to compare specific sections. It will highlight additions, deletions, and modifications at the clause level, with full context from both versions side by side.
faq.a3: Every answer Allybi provides cites the exact source document, page number, and relevant passage. Grounding is enforced at the architecture level — if the information does not exist in your uploaded files, Allybi will say so rather than fabricate an answer.
faq.a4: Yes. All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Your documents are never used to train AI models — this is contractually guaranteed. You can choose EU or US data hosting.
faq.q5: Can I control who accesses my workspace?
faq.a5: Yes. Each project workspace has its own access controls. You decide who can view, edit, or search within a matter. Workspaces are fully isolated — no data leaks between projects or accounts.
faq.q6: How does the send confirmation work?
faq.a6: Before any file leaves your workspace — whether attached to an email or shared via link — Allybi shows you the exact file name, version, modification date, and recipient. You must explicitly confirm before the action completes. This prevents accidental sends of wrong versions.

security.q1: Does Allybi train on my documents?
security.a1: No. Your documents are never used to train AI models. This is contractually guaranteed. Allybi uses your files only to generate answers in your workspace.
security.a2: All data is encrypted with TLS in transit and AES-256-GCM at rest. Encryption keys are managed separately from document storage. Workspaces are isolated so no data leaks between projects or users.

sending.q1: What happens before an email is sent?
sending.a1: Allybi always shows a confirmation screen before anything is sent. You review the content, recipient, attachments, and version before confirming. Nothing leaves without your explicit approval.
sending.q2: Can I review before WhatsApp handoff?
sending.a2: Yes. WhatsApp handoff follows the same review-before-send pattern. You see the message content and recipient before Allybi opens WhatsApp. Nothing is sent automatically.

pricing.a1: Allybi is currently in 30 days free phase. Book a demo and we will walk you through the product, set up your workspace, and configure your integrations with you.
pricing.a2: We work directly with each team during the 30 days free phase to ensure Allybi fits your workflow. Book a demo to discuss access options and onboarding.

usecases.q1: Is Allybi built for legal work?
usecases.a1: Yes. Allybi was designed for professionals handling sensitive documents. Compare clauses between contract versions, search across matter files, and send the right version with confirmation. All projects are isolated and encrypted.
usecases.a2: Absolutely. Finance teams use Allybi to search across board decks, models, and reports. Pull revenue figures, compare quarterly data, and get answers with exact file and page references.
